name: Zeno Village Resort
tagline: Serene glass-walled private pool villas hidden in the cloud forests of 900 Kandi.
description: An architectural marvel nestled inside mist-veiled rainforests, featuring luxury private heated plunge pools, glass bay suites, and uninterrupted valley views.
longDescription: Perched along the emerald slopes of 900 Kandi, Zeno Village Resort redefines mountain luxury in Wayanad. The resort features private pool villas designed with natural stone and floor-to-ceiling glass that frame dramatic mountain sunsets. Wake up to swirling mist, swim in your private temperature-balanced pool, and enjoy farm-to-table Kerala dining on private wooden decks overlooking tropical valleys.
priceNote: Includes estate breakfast, nature trails, and sunset high tea.
curatedHighlights: Infinity pool on timber deck overlooking mist-shrouded 900 Kandi mountain ridges
Architectural glass A-frame cabins nestled over rainforest streams with private bridge walkway
Thatched-roof treehouses secluded 40 feet in virgin rainforest canopy
Curved wooden glamping pods with private balconies amidst coffee groves

villas.name: Valley Infinity Pool Suite
villas.bedType: Plush King Bed with Valley Vista

policies.cancellation: Complimentary alteration up to 7 days before arrival.
policies.childPolicy: Children welcome. Safe enclosed pool villas.
policies.additionalNote: Private 4WD escort arranged from Meppadi base.

name: Mountain Shadow
tagline: Eco-luxury sanctuary perched on an exclusive peninsula surrounded by lake waters.
locationSummary: Set on a private waterfront peninsula in Meppadi overlooking Karapuzha reservoir and Chembra Peak.
description: An extraordinary eco-resort built with recycled wood and thatch, commanding infinity pool views across tranquil reservoir waters and high Western Ghats ridges.
longDescription: Set upon a secluded peninsula surrounded by calm waters and framed by Chembra Peak, Mountain Shadow offers unmatched tranquility. Each villa is an ode to understated luxury, featuring private wooden balconies, deep soaking bathtubs, private plunge pools, and uninterrupted horizons of blue waters and lush greenery.
priceNote: Includes gourmet waterfront breakfast, kayak access, and guided tea walks.
curatedHighlights: Wake up to 360° water and mountain panoramas from your bed
Private infinity pool floating above the reservoir shoreline
Sunset kayaking along quiet uninhabited island banks
Traditional Kerala Sadya prepared by master chefs

policies.cancellation: Full flexibility with 7 days advance notice.
policies.childPolicy: Children welcome. Kayak life jackets provided for all ages.

name: Pepper Trail
tagline: 200-year-old colonial plantation manor and luxury treehouses in a 200-acre coffee estate.
locationSummary: Historic 200-acre coffee, pepper and clove estate in Sultan Bathery, near Edakkal Caves.
description: A heritage sanctuary rooted in the planter era of the 1800s, featuring restored colonial suites, elevated canopy treehouses, and private swimming pool villas inside aromatic spice groves.
longDescription: Step into an era of graceful hospitality at Pepper Trail. Nestled amidst 200 acres of working coffee, clove, and pepper plantations, the estate preserves ancestral heritage with antique four-poster beds, hand-carved teak verandas, and open courtyards. Reside in private pool villas secluded amidst flowering shrubs or treehouses 40 feet in ancient trees.
priceNote: Includes planter's breakfast, plantation tour, coracle rides on private lake, and high tea.
curatedHighlights: Private pool villa encircled by flowering coffee and pepper vines
Early morning coracle ride on the private estate lake with resident naturalists
Traditional Syrian Christian and Malabar culinary masterclasses
Authentic 19th-century colonial furniture and heritage craftsmanship

policies.cancellation: Full refund 7 days prior to arrival.
policies.childPolicy: Children welcome. Treehouses suitable for ages 10+.
policies.additionalNote: Accessible from Calicut (2.5 hrs), Mysore (2 hrs) or Bangalore (5.5 hrs).

name: Munnar Cloud Reserve
tagline: Perched 1,600 meters above sea level where emerald tea hills meet morning mountain mist.
locationSummary: Private colonial tea estate in Chinnakanal, overlooking Anayirankal Dam.
description: An intimate mountain hideaway set inside sprawling organic tea slopes, featuring roaring wood fireplaces, heated infinity pool facing the clouds, and panoramic valley views.
longDescription: Escape to the cool highlands of Munnar, where the scent of eucalyptus and tea blossoms fills the mountain breeze. Munnar Cloud Reserve offers stone chalets with heated plunge tubs, tea plucking experiences, and fireside evenings.
priceNote: Includes artisanal planter's breakfast and guided estate walks.
curatedHighlights: Unbroken vistas of morning mist cascading over tea slopes

name: Alleppey Lakefront Heritage Sanctuary
tagline: Restored Kerala Nalukettu courtyards bordering the tranquil Vembanad Lake.
locationSummary: Secluded lakefront peninsula on Vembanad Lake, 75 minutes from Kochi Airport.
description: An authentic tribute to traditional Kerala architecture featuring private plunge pools, open-to-sky courtyards, and uninterrupted sunsets over the backwaters.
longDescription: Set upon the peaceful shores of Vembanad Lake, master carpenters have restored ancestral Tharavadu manors dating back to the 18th century, integrating private plunge pools and sunset boat cruises.
priceNote: Includes traditional breakfast, sunset boat cruise, and afternoon tea.
curatedHighlights: Authentic Nalukettu timber architecture restored by master wood artisans
Private sunset cruise aboard traditional kettuvallam

policies.cancellation: Flexible up to 7 days before arrival.
